svg.aria-label: How modules are registered and looked up: core/registry/default.go is the only file naming modules and registers every transport, proxy protocol, sniffer, DNS server and API into typed tables. Trojan and VLESS are each registered once, as a module that fills the stream and datagram-over-stream kinds. Every registration is checked; config.Parse looks modules up by name and position.
svg.title: How modules are registered and looked up

text.tspan: one module may fill several kinds
The only file that names modules.
No init(), no blank imports, no globals.
A Go program can build its own registry
with modules Apranik has never heard of.
Info() is constant: called twice, compared
the same name twice in one kind: refused
the constructor's return type is the kind,
so a wrong kind does not compile
protocol -> a proxy protocol, and its
datagram-over-stream kind if it has one
